documents.title: Illustrative billing escalation guidance
documents.excerpt: Synthetic example only: repeated reported payment charges with missing Pro access require billing review. Preserve whether charges are pending or settled as unknown. Request human investigation; do not promise a refund, reversal deadline, or confirmed payment outcome.

documents.title: Illustrative theme issue investigation
documents.excerpt: Synthetic example only: when System Default stays light despite macOS dark mode, record a possible theme bug for product support. Preserve a separate feature request for scheduled dark mode. Do not repeat failed settings advice or claim a dark-mode toggle or scheduling feature actually exists.
